description: This file contains internal hash functions, classes, and traits used by the Abseil C++ library for hashing various data types, including support for composite types, pointers, strings, containers, and custom hash states.

classes.name: absl::hash_internal::PiecewiseCombiner
classes.description: Helper class for hashing buffers in chunks, supporting add_buffer and finalize methods.

classes.name: absl::hash_internal::HashStateBase
classes.description: CRTP base class providing common hash state operations like combine, combine_contiguous, and combine_unordered.

classes.name: absl::hash_internal::MixingHashState
classes.description: Hash state class implementing a mixing hash algorithm with support for combining byte ranges and unordered collections.

methods.name: PiecewiseCombiner::add_buffer
methods.description: Adds a buffer segment to the hash sequence, handling partial chunks.

methods.name: PiecewiseCombiner::finalize
methods.description: Finalizes the hash by processing any remaining buffered data.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine
methods.description: Combines multiple values into a hash state.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine_contiguous
methods.description: Combines a contiguous array of elements into a hash state.

methods.name: HashStateBase::combine_unordered
methods.description: Combines elements in an unordered collection into a hash state.

methods.name: MixingHashState::hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a given integral or non-integral type.
